eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Montcalm, MI; at 6:35 PM on AUG 29, 2020 Effective until 8:05 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The National Weather Service has issued a * Severe Thunderstorm Warning for... Montcalm County...  * Until 1030 PM EDT. *HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees. *
